name: @pipeworx/mcp-didit

tools.name: didit_aml
tools.description: Screen a person (or entity) against 1,300+ global sanctions, PEP, watchlist, and adverse-media lists using the Didit AML API. Returns an overall status + risk score plus each individual hit (sanctions/PEP/adverse-media matches). Example: didit_aml({ full_name: "Vladimir Putin", date_of_birth: "1952-10-07", nationality: "RU", _apiKey: "your-key" })

full_name.description: Full name of the person or entity to screen, e.g. "Antonio Ejemplo Modelo"

date_of_birth.description: Optional date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "1972-02-29". Improves match precision.

nationality.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country/nationality code, e.g. "ES", "US". Also accepted as `country`.

document_number.description: Optional government ID / document number for higher-confidence matching.

include_adverse_media.description: Include adverse-media screening. Adds ~10s to the request. Default false.

_apiKey.description: Didit API key. Get one at https://didit.me/pricing (docs: https://docs.didit.me/).

tools.name: didit_kyb
tools.description: Business (KYB) verification via the Didit company registry. Given a company name (+ country), returns the matched company profile (registration number, status, address, incorporation date) plus officers/directors and UBO/beneficial-owner ownership. Resolves the free registry search then pulls the full billable profile in one call. Example: didit_kyb({ name: "Stripe Inc", country: "US", _apiKey: "your-key" })

name.description: Company name to look up, e.g. "Stripe Inc". Also accepted as `company_name`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the company is registered in, e.g. "US", "GB", "ES".

registration_number.description: Optional company registration number to disambiguate.

kyb_response_id.description: Optional: a kyb_response_id from a prior search to skip re-searching.

company_id.description: Optional: the candidate company_id to select when a kyb_response_id is provided.

_apiKey.description: Didit API key. Get one at https://didit.me/pricing (docs: https://docs.didit.me/).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-didit forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the didit pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
